facts.fact: On 6 Oct 2026 the Union Cabinet approved setting up the Integrated Transport & Logistics Authority (ITLA)
facts.quote: Cabinet approves setting up of Integrated Transport & Logistics Authority Posted On: 06 OCT 2026 3:09PM by PIB Delhi

facts.fact: On 6 Oct 2026 the Union Cabinet approved a Rs 10,000 crore commitment towards the SME Growth Fund
facts.quote: Cabinet approves Commitment of Rs.10,000 Crore towards establishment of the SME Growth Fund for direct equity investments in Small and Medium Enterprises to create future champions Posted On: 06 OCT 2026 3:14PM by PIB Delhi

summary: PIB releases of 6 Oct 2026 confirm the Cabinet approved the ITLA and a Rs 10,000 crore commitment to the SME Growth Fund.
